Field notes · October

Autumn at the footbridge

What we found at the footbridge, and what to do before winter.

The river

The river , and both times the footbridge held. The second rise came within a hand of the deck boards, which is closer than any year since the bridge was rebuilt.

MLMaya Lindqvist3m ago

Was it twice? The log says once, on the 14th.

We recommend raising the deck by one course before the spring melt. The cost is modest and the work can be done in two days with the water low.

MLMaya Lindqvist5m ago

Two days is optimistic. Last time the same job took a week; say so, or give a range.

The path

MLMaya Lindqvistjust now

A map of the north bank here would help.

The path on the north bank is washed out for about twenty metres. Walkers are cutting across the meadow, which is doing more harm than the river did.

  1. Add your name

This screen

Add your name

Open in prototypereview.html#add-your-name

Let Maya put her name on her comments without leaving the menu: the who-you-are row turns into a name field in place.

Persona at this step
MLMaya Lindqvist

Maya has been "Otter" so far. Before she sends her comments back she wants her colleague to see her name on them.

Content
  • The menu open above the tag. Its first row has turned into a text field in place (default): her avatar and the field holding "Maya Lindqvist" with the cursor at its end, nothing else on the row; the rest of the menu stays as it was.
  • After Enter (success): the row shows her avatar, "Maya Lindqvist" and the edit mark again, and every card on the page reads Maya Lindqvist.
Wording
  • {name} the name she gave, on the row, on every card and in the copied Markdown.
  • Add name the row's action until a name is given; the edit mark afterwards.
Components
Comment cardPopover menu iconAvatar smButton quietComment control cornerHighlightIcon button quietKeyPinText field
States
  • EmptyNot applicable
  • LoadingNot applicable
  • ErrorNot applicable
Interactions
  • Choosing Add name (or the edit mark) turns the row into the field in place, with the cursor in it; nothing else moves (instant: the row changes in place and the field must be ready to type in at once).
  • Enter or leaving the field saves; Esc cancels and leaves the menu open. The menu never closes while the name is being edited.
  • The name is kept for this page in this browser; the animal name comes back only if the field is left empty.
  • The compose card's "edit name" does the same in place on the card.
Requirements
  • FR-011 A reviewer can add or change their name in place on the menu's first row (and on the compose card), with Enter or leaving the field saving and Esc cancelling, and the name shows on every card and in every copy.
Acceptance criteria
  1. AC-add-your-name-1FR-011PassedGiven the menu open, when Maya chooses the edit mark, then the first row becomes a text field holding her current name with the cursor at its end, and the menu stays open.
  2. AC-add-your-name-2FR-011PassedGiven the field, when she types a name and presses Enter, then the row shows that name with the edit mark, and every card on the page shows it.
  3. AC-add-your-name-3FR-011PassedGiven the field, when she presses Esc, then the row shows the name she had and the menu is still open.

Say who you are

Maya puts her name on her comments from the menu, without an account, so her colleague sees who said what.

Goal
Maya's comments carry her name instead of an animal, with no account and no sign-in.
Trigger
She is about to send her comments back and wants her colleague to see her name on them.
Outcome
Every card and every copy shows her name, and it is kept for this page in this browser.
Success
A name takes one press and a few keystrokes, and is never required (SC-001).
